objective: Prepare the bounded D1 long-lived Blaine platform foundation: observed inventory, service ownership, pragmatic Ansible, safe local backup machinery, and recovery acceptance preparation; integrate a coherent validated PASS or STOP into local main.

context.need: Accepted local platform direction and explicit D1 scope
User-directed pause and checkpoint; next D1 workstream is missing infrastructure, not blocked by backup

capabilities: commit and fast-forward local main at integration

allowed: read-only host inspection without secret values
coherent commits and safe local-main integration
ask_before: disk selection/preparation where identity or existing data requires a human decision
forbidden: format/repartition/repair/change UUID or alter any existing historical backup contents on the authorized SSD
while backup is PAUSED: live backup/restore execution, identity/PAM/systemd debugging, disk changes, service deployment, timer activation, or new infrastructure installation

completion.criterion: Inventory and service ownership distinguish observation from desired state
Backup safeguards and available restore machinery have isolated evidence
completion.evidence: tests/platform/test_backup.py and infra/validation-d1.json, with physical disk and S3 gaps explicit

completion.criterion: Ansible staging is convergent and units validate
completion.evidence: syntax/unit checks and two scratch staging recaps

completion.criterion: Recovery gates, remaining human decisions, and integration result are truthful
completion.evidence: docs/platform-operations.md, Git history, and final D1 report
